title: hiwf-world-heavyweight
label: "Mr. Universe" Tommy Drummond
note: Won the steel-cage final of the fed's own World Title Tournament on the technicality that his feet touched the floor first; the held record does not show the reign ending before it is carried, still on his chest, into a promo staged inside a different federation in December 1997.
notes: End of reign unrecorded (unrecorded). Event: S.Y.M., 15 July 1997

title: hiwf-world-tag-team
label: The L.A. Mafia
note: Won a Tag Team Title Death Match over the Hate Machine on a last-second pinfall at 59:59 of a sixty-minute limit.
notes: End of reign unrecorded (lost). Event: S.Y.M., 15 July 1997

title: hiwf-world-tag-team
label: The Nobles
note: Regained the titles from the L.A. Mafia by defeating the Hate Machine again, narrated in the fed's own cross-federation magazine rather than shown on a surviving card; the held record does not trace the reign further.
